function: Joint device activity detection and channel estimation in grant-free MIMO-OFDM; score networks learn the channel prior used as MMSE denoiser in message passing (p. 2, 9).
system: Uplink grant-free MIMO-OFDM: BS with 32-antenna ULA, single-antenna devices, K=800, N=48 subcarriers, 2.6 GHz; no RIS (p. 11).
method: NCSNv2 and NCSN score networks trained by denoising score matching (unsupervised, generative), plugged into turbo message passing as MMSE denoiser (p. 8, 11).
data_channel: 3GPP TR 38.901 CDL-C generated with QuaDRiGa: 50,000 training samples with randomized angles, delays, gains; 5,000 CDL-C evaluation samples (p. 11).
test_conditions: Trained on CDL-C, SNR -10 to 30 dB; tested on CDL-C and on unseen CDL-B, other activity probabilities, pilot lengths, DFT/Hadamard pilots, without retraining (p. 11, 14).
baselines: Non-learned only: LS, OMP, element-wise MMSE, VALSE, genie bound (denoising); BG-TMP, GMMV-AMP, TMP-EM (JADCE). No earlier learned JADCE method compared (p. 12).
metrics: Channel-estimation NMSE, device detection error probability (missed detections plus false alarms), convergence versus iterations, supported number of devices (p. 12-13).
complexity: Per-iteration O(MNK log2 K + C), counted in complex multiplications; C is the score-network forward cost, not quantified numerically; training takes about one day per network (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 11: "models generated from the QuaDRiGa toolbox [55] for training and evaluation"; evaluation samples come from CDL-C of 3GPP TR 38.901 [32] (p. 11).
q2_support: p. 14: "the score networks are trained on the CDL-C dataset, while the STMP-JADCE algorithm is evaluated on the distinct CDL-B channel model".
q3_support: p. 12: "Generalized MMV-AMP (GMMV-AMP) [11]" and TMP-EM [27], BG-TMP are model-based, non-learned; no earlier learned JADCE method is simulated (deep unfolding [8], [9], [12] and LSTM [35] appear only in related work, p. 3).
q4_support: p. 11: "The computational complexity of STMP-JADCE is evaluated in terms of the number of complex multiplications." Order O(MNK log2 K + C) is given.
q5_support: p. 11: "The evaluation samples are directly generated from the CDL-C"; the dataset is self-generated with QuaDRiGa, and no code or data link appears in the 16 pages.
notes: Preprint is arXiv 2506.00581v2 (7 Feb 2026). Included as area 2: the learned element is the score-based channel prior (channel denoising), headline metric is channel-estimation NMSE (p. 2: 5 dB NMSE gain). Activity detection is analytic (p. 9: "the device activity denoiser and the linear estimator are derived analytically"), so the learned part is the channel prior. BS has 32 antennas, so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply.
